heroNarrative.title: The budget lands. Then the silence.
heroNarrative.lede: From the Exchequer to the mwananchi, we track the money, verify the numbers, and turn Kenya’s public spending into evidence people can understand, question, and act on.

thesis.title: Three bets. Year-round accountability.
thesis.body: Beyond the budget. Into the evidence. We verify the numbers, follow delivery on the ground, and equip journalists to keep public money under scrutiny long after Budget Day.

programmeExplains.name: BNS Connect
programmeExplains.title: National budget intelligence
programmeExplains.lede: We verify what Treasury publishes and keep national debt and allocation questions alive after Budget Day.
programmeExplains.success: Success looks like: Treasury and debt questions stay visible from budget books to implementation, with public evidence driving follow-through.

programmeExplains.name: BNS Mashinani
programmeExplains.title: County delivery verification
programmeExplains.lede: Full-cycle embeds in Kakamega, Kilifi, Nakuru, and Wajir track whether equitable share reaches clinics, roads, and schools.
programmeExplains.success: Success looks like: county budgets are checked in real time, with delivery evidence and citizen questions kept in the same public conversation.

programmeExplains.name: Wanahabari Lab
programmeExplains.title: Newsroom scrutiny
programmeExplains.lede: Training and co-production keep journalists forensic after Budget Day, when the spending story actually begins.
programmeExplains.success: Success looks like: journalists keep the public narrative grounded in evidence, turning policy gaps and delivery failures into accountable reporting.

featuredIntro.headline: Evidence that can be briefed, shared, and acted on
featuredIntro.lede: From AFRODAD debt forums and Red Flags investigations to Project TERRA, we turn real public-finance conversations into films, field stories, and evidence partners can use.

partnerCta.title: See the work. Ask the question. Join the public record.
partnerCta.description: National budget intelligence, county delivery verification, and newsroom scrutiny all work best when evidence is shared with the public and partners who need it.

hero.body: Kenya's public money moves fast, and mostly out of sight. We turn opaque fiscal policy into verified intelligence for partners, institutions, and newsrooms  --  nationally and in select counties.

storyIntro.title: Featured programme evidence
storyIntro.body: House of Fiscal Wisdom with Dr. Lyla Latif  --  forensic briefing on illicit financial flows, produced with Wanahabari Lab as evidence partners can brief against.

programmesStrip.title: Our programmes
programmesStrip.description: Connect, Mashinani, and Wanahabari  --  with production and commissions captured through BNS Studio.

tiktok.description: Snackable explainers that meet youth where they scroll  --  turning county fiscal data into stories anyone can share.

team.description: A dedicated group of researchers, storytellers, and tech innovators working together to bring transparency to Kenya's public budgets.

gallery.description: Moments from civic workshops, town halls, and community engagements across the country.

studioStrip.description: Browse commissioned podcasts, documentaries, animations, and civic campaigns organised by content type and organisation  --  every project helps fund Kenya's leading youth budget platform.
studioStrip.highlight: Every commission is double impact: evidence-based content for your audience, with proceeds reinvested into Budget Ndio Story's civic mission.
